review_passes.name: evidence_content_and_packaging
review_passes.description: Question, reference, frozen final input, provenance, and canonical source were reviewed before candidate utilisation.

review_passes.name: answerer_utilisation
review_passes.description: Candidate use was reviewed only after semantic sufficiency was fixed.

guards: Locator Any-hit and All-hit are diagnostic coverage signals, not semantic sufficiency labels.
Gold annotations are non-exhaustive; complete alternative answer-bearing support may establish sufficiency despite locator no-hit.
Direct source/reference contradiction is distinguished from mere under-support of an overprecise reference.
Utilisation is not assigned when semantic sufficiency is partial, absent, or indeterminate.
Rows contain no question, reference, candidate-answer, or evidence text.
